description: Free LLM agent security review in ~35s. Two parts: (1) 8 live adversarial probes (jailbreak / prompt injection / system-prompt extraction / tool abuse) against your agent spec, and (2) a deterministic static audit of which guardrails the spec text itself is missing. Returns a 0-100 risk score, per-finding evidence, and a paste-ready guardrail sentence for each gap.
name: run_free_scan
